intake.decision_clock: Standard review. Pharmacy benefit: 72 hours; medical benefit: 7 calendar days, from receipt of all required information (policy section E).

notes: Two submissions: iv induction via the medical benefit; sc maintenance via the pharmacy benefit

indications: Moderately to severely active Crohn's disease in adults (age 18 and older)
Moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis in adults (age 18 and older)

criteria.text: The member has moderately to severely active Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis, as stated by the prescriber in the clinical record.
evidence_needed: Prescriber statement in the clinical record of moderately to severely active CD or UC

criteria.text: Disease activity is confirmed by direct visualization: an ileocolonoscopy, colonoscopy, or flexible sigmoidoscopy performed within the past 12 months that documents active mucosal inflammation. Laboratory markers (including fecal calprotectin, C-reactive protein, and sedimentation rate) do not meet this requirement on their own, and neither do cross-sectional imaging studies.
evidence_needed: Endoscopy or colonoscopy or flexible sigmoidoscopy report dated within the past 12 months
Endoscopy report documenting active mucosal inflammation
Note that calprotectin, CRP, sedimentation rate, or cross-sectional imaging alone does not satisfy this item

criteria.text: The prescriber is a gastroenterologist, or the prescriber has consulted with a gastroenterologist about this treatment.
evidence_needed: Prescriber specialty listed as gastroenterology, or
Documentation of a consultation with a gastroenterologist about ustekinumab

criteria.text: The member is at least 18 years old on the date of the request.
evidence_needed: Member date of birth showing age 18 or older on the request date

criteria.text: The member has tried at least one prior therapy for CD or UC, shown by either sub-criterion (a) or (b); one is enough. The record identifies the drug, roughly when it was used, and why it was stopped. A trial of a TNF blocker before ustekinumab is not required.
evidence_needed: Name of each prior therapy, approximate dates of use, and reason stopped (inadequate response, intolerance, or contraindication)

sub_criteria.text: A conventional agent (oral or intravenous corticosteroid, budesonide, azathioprine, mercaptopurine, or methotrexate; for UC, oral 5-aminosalicylate) was stopped or found insufficient because of inadequate response, intolerance, or contraindication.
evidence_needed: Record of a listed conventional agent, approximate dates of use, and reason stopped or found insufficient

sub_criteria.text: A biologic or targeted synthetic agent for CD or UC (for example adalimumab, infliximab, vedolizumab, certolizumab, risankizumab, tofacitinib, upadacitinib, ozanimod) was stopped or found insufficient because of inadequate response or intolerance, or there is a documented contraindication to TNF blockers.
evidence_needed: Record of a biologic or targeted synthetic agent, approximate dates of use, and reason stopped (inadequate response or intolerance), or
Documented contraindication to TNF blockers

criteria.text: Tuberculosis has been screened for with an interferon-gamma release assay or tuberculin skin test with a negative result within the past 6 months. An indeterminate or borderline result is not negative. A member with a positive screen qualifies only if the record shows a chest radiograph without active disease and that treatment for latent infection has begun.
evidence_needed: IGRA or tuberculin skin test result dated within the past 6 months, reported as negative
If screen positive: chest radiograph report showing no active disease and documentation that latent TB treatment has started

criteria.text: Hepatitis B status is documented with results for hepatitis B surface antigen and total hepatitis B core antibody, of any age. A reactive result requires a documented plan for antiviral prophylaxis or monitoring. Surface antibody results and vaccination records are not sufficient. Pending orders are not sufficient.
evidence_needed: Hepatitis B surface antigen result
Total hepatitis B core antibody result
If reactive: documented plan for antiviral prophylaxis or monitoring

criteria.text: Ustekinumab will not be combined with any other biologic, JAK inhibitor, or S1P receptor modulator for CD or UC. When the member is switching from one of these agents, the record shows the earlier agent is stopping.
evidence_needed: Current medication list showing no concurrent biologic, JAK inhibitor, or S1P receptor modulator for CD or UC
If switching: documentation that the earlier biologic, JAK inhibitor, or S1P receptor modulator is being stopped

criteria.text: The requested regimen is the labeled adult regimen: one weight-based intravenous induction infusion (260 mg up to and including 55 kg; 390 mg above 55 kg up to and including 85 kg; 520 mg above 85 kg), then 90 mg subcutaneously every 8 weeks beginning 8 weeks after the infusion. A body weight recorded in the 90 days before the request must be on file.
evidence_needed: Requested induction dose matching the member's weight band (260 mg, 390 mg, or 520 mg)
Requested maintenance dose of 90 mg subcutaneously every 8 weeks starting 8 weeks after induction
Body weight recorded within the 90 days before the request
